```artifact
Feature: System Back-up and Reports

  Scenario: Full back-up of the system every night
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the day
    Then a full back-up of the system (both Database and Code) shall be taken
    And the back-up shall be sent to the remote site for safekeeping
    And the back-up shall be rotated every 30 days

  Scenario: Doctors/Chemists and Labs can change their password and log-in
    Given a user is logged in as a Doctor, Chemist, or Lab
    When the user clicks on the "Change Password" option
    And enters the new password and confirms it
    Then the user's password shall be updated
    And the user shall be able to log-in using the new password

  Scenario: Patients create a User-id/Password for authentication
    Given a patient is registering for the system
    When the patient enters a new User-id and Password
    And confirms the Password
    Then the patient's User-id and Password shall be created
    And the patient shall be able to log-in using the created User-id and Password

Feature: Reports Generation

  Scenario Outline: Doctor wise Appointment file for next 5 days
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the day
    And the system generates the Doctor wise Appointment file for next 5 days
    Then the file shall contain the appointments for the next 5 days
    Examples:
      | Doctor ID | Appointment Date | Appointment Time |
      |-----------|------------------|------------------|
      | D001      | 2023-04-10       | 10:00 AM         |
      | D002      | 2023-04-11       | 11:00 AM         |

  Scenario Outline: Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per month/quarter/year
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the month/quarter/year
    And the system generates the Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per month/quarter/year
    Then the report shall contain the number of consultations by each doctor
    Examples:
      | Speciality | Doctor ID | Number of Consultations |
      |------------|-----------|-------------------------|
      | Cardiology | D001      | 10                      |
      | Pediatrics | D002      | 15                      |

  Scenario Outline: Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per month/quarter/year
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the month/quarter/year
    And the system generates the Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per month/quarter/year
    Then the report shall contain the revenue earned by each doctor
    Examples:
      | Speciality | Doctor ID | Revenue Earned |
      |------------|-----------|----------------|
      | Cardiology | D001      | $5000          |
      | Pediatrics | D002      | $7500          |
```
